subject: Proposal: 3-week pilot bridge with graduated unit credits and rollback SLA
messages:

Cc: procurement@clamorhealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Short extension & SLA ask for upcoming demo

Hi Rachel,

Quick one — our internal pilot is finishing Friday but we've had a sudden uptick in traffic from a partner integration. Can Clamor get a short bridge so we can finish a staged demo next week? Ideally: 2–3 weeks of runway while we finalize procurement.

Two specific asks:
- Can you outline a credit-based option (so we only pay for what we use) vs a short flat top-up?
- We also need a narrow SLA/rollback for latency (p95) so the demo team can confidently present the live experience.

If possible, we’d like an invoice/DocuSign-ready package today — procurement is standing by.

Thanks,
Emma

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short extension & SLA ask for upcoming demo

Hi Emma — thanks for the note. We can absolutely cover a 3-week bridge; below are two clean paths so procurement can pick what fits best. I’ve attached a short spreadsheet and an SLA FAQ for the rollback mechanics.

Option A — Bridge (recommended for minimal paperwork)
- Duration: 3 weeks (starts on sign)
- Model: credit pool (prepaid) with graduated top-up pricing:
  * Week 1: 1.0x unit price (baseline)
  * Week 2: 0.9x unit price (10% discount)
  * Week 3: 0.8x unit price (20% discount)
- Billing: invoice on sign for the full prepaid amount; unused credits convert to account credit or apply to first invoice after conversion.

Option B — Short fixed top-up (simpler accounting)
- Single invoice for a fixed amount (we propose $6,000) to cover expected burst capacity; unused dollars credited.

Rollback SLA (applies to both options)
- SLO: p95 inference latency <= 700ms (us-west region)
- If p95 > 700ms for more than 3 of 7 consecutive days during the bridge window, we issue a pro-rated credit equal to 10% of the prepaid bridge for each full 7-day period above threshold (capped at 50%).
- Credits applied to account as invoice credits; not cash refunds.

Docs & next steps
- Attached: Proposed-3wk-bridge.xlsx (breakdown + invoice templates), SLA-Rollback-FAQ.pdf
- If procurement confirms option A, we’ll issue an invoice and DocuSign packet immediately.

Looping in David for the invoice flow and Marissa for approval on the graduated discount. Emma — is waiver of any onboarding setup fee required to move forward today?

Cheers,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Success, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
